ImageDescription.value: The Busan International Fireworks Festival (Korean: 부산국제불꽃축제), held annually at Gwangalli Beach, Busan, South Korea, is one of the most significant fireworks festivals in Asia. Tens of thousands of fireworks and state-of-the-art lasers light up the night sky in harmony with theme songs of the festival against a backdrop of the sea and the two-level suspension bridge, Gwangan Bridge.
